blockNote: Slope physics for eastward player movement (186435-187085, Bank 02). The four handlers are entered ONLY from DispatchEastMove (player_move_east); the diagonal dispatcher has its own ramp code (DiagRampUpLeft and friends) and does not call here. The older header said 'shared between east and diagonal dispatchers'.

They call back into player_move_diag (DiagClearReturnFlags), player_move_east (EastWallNorthDiag / EastWallSouthDiag), player_move_south (SnapYSouthCollision) and player_move_ns (SnapYNorthCollision).
=== ENTRY MAP ===
EastRampDown : ProbeLeftTiles found $0A (carry clear)
WestRampUp   : ProbeLeftTiles found $05 (carry set)
EastRampUp   : ProbeCurrentBL read $0A (late path of DispatchEastMove)
WestRampDown : ProbeCurrentBL read $05
(The header of player_move_east says the $05 ProbeLeftTiles result goes to WestRampDown; its code jumps to WestRampUp.)

Tile types: $0A (east-facing) is a surface that falls toward the east, Y grows with X; $05 (west-facing) rises toward the east. Both direct paths agree: $0A adds the X velocity to Y ($26 += $20), $05 subtracts it. 'Up' / 'Down' in the names is not the Y direction: EastRampUp's direct path also descends.
=== COORDINATES ===

$1A is the probe pixel X and $1E the probe pixel Y (tile_collision convention). '$1A -= 8' therefore moves the probe 8 px WEST; it is not 'Y up' as many older inline comments said. ProbeCurrentTR leaves $1A = X + 8 and $1E = Y - 16 (hitbox top row); ProbeCurrentBR leaves $1A = X + 8 and $1E = Y (bottom + 1); ProbeCurrentBL leaves $1A = X - 8 and $1E = Y. The -8 / +8 therefore lands on the hitbox centre column X. FutureTR minus 9 is one pixel west of the post-step centre column.
=== COMMON FLOW ===
1. DiagClearReturnFlags zeroes the word at $05,S, the vertical velocity PlayerMovementTick parked on its stack, so the NS phase later does nothing and these handlers own the Y movement.
2. Probe the slope type in several cells (listed in each handler note). No slope: the Redirect handlers (FutureTR $09 -> EastWallNorthDiag, FutureBR $06 -> EastWallSouthDiag) or ApplyMovementDeltas.
3. Slope found:
- direct entries (the first samples hit the slope cell or the cell next to it, no crossing test): $26 -/+= $20, the X velocity copied 1:1 into Y (a 45-degree slope).

- after the future probe: CheckTileBoundaryXor (Z clear = this step crosses a 16-px column line). No crossing: plain ApplyMovementDeltas. Crossing: n = ((X + step) in px) AND $0F, the pixels past the line. EastRampDown: $26 += 4n; WestRampUp: $26 -= 4n; then +4 / -4 (one pixel; positions are quarter pixels) when bit 2 of ($26 + $20 + $22) is set (a Y position plus X values, as in the original). EastRampUp / WestRampDown instead set $24 = $20 - 4n / 4n - $20, which ApplyMovementDeltas applies.

4. playerFlags |= $1000 (on slope / ramp), then the FutureTR and FutureBR wall check ($0E+ = solid): both open -> ApplyMovementDeltas; TR open and BR solid -> SnapYSouthCollision; TR solid and BR open -> SnapYNorthCollision; both solid -> corner snap.

5. Corner snap: X = (left edge of the post-step position, floored to a 16-px column line) + 8, so it only ever moves west; $26 += old X + $20 - new X (the distance pulled back); $20, $24 and playerSpeedEw are zeroed and SetActorCollisionFlag is called. The Y compensation has the same sign in the $0A and $05 handlers (OQ-I038-2).
Everything here is UNVERIFIED-RUNTIME (no emulator trace); the arithmetic is read from the code.

EastRampDown: Entered when ProbeLeftTiles found $0A: descend while moving east. Samples: TR probe at (X, top row); the cell below it; FutureTR at (X + step - 1); the cell below that. Hits on the first two take the direct step (code_02D8C7); hits on the last two take the column-crossing test; no hit -> EastRedirectToNorth. See the block note.
EastRampUp: Entered from DispatchEastMove when ProbeCurrentBL read $0A. Samples (X, bottom + 1); not $0A -> ApplyMovementDeltas. $0A with no column crossing -> the direct step (Y += $20); with a crossing $24 = $20 - 4n (n = pixels past the column line after the step). Finishes at code_02D8CE.
WestRampUp: Entered when ProbeLeftTiles found $05. Mirror of EastRampDown: BR probe at (X, bottom + 1), MapCellUp on the first retry, FutureTR at (X + step - 1) then MapCellDown, and negated Y (crossing: $26 -= 4n with a -4 bias; direct: $26 -= $20). Finishes at code_02DA19 with the same snaps.
WestRampDown: Entered from DispatchEastMove when ProbeCurrentBL read $05. Samples (X, bottom + 1) for $05; no crossing -> code_02DA0E (Y -= $20); crossing: $24 = 4n - $20 (n as in EastRampUp), negative (upward) while 4n < $20. Y grows downward, so the older 'positive, producing upward displacement' was wrong. Finishes at code_02DA19.

blockNote: Per-frame actor: cameraDeltaX = cameraTargetX, and bit 9 ($0200) of the frame counter $0036 (incremented once per frame in the NMI) selects INC (bit set) or DEC (bit clear) of cameraDeltaY.
Bit 9 flips every 512 frames, so cameraDeltaY ramps up 512 steps and back down 512 steps (about 8.5 s per half at 60 Hz): a slow vertical drift, not the 'subtle wobble' the older header claimed.

cameraDeltaX / Y are not the camera itself: camera_tilemap copies them into effectScrollH / V in layer-1 delta mode ($06EF bit 2), and camera_scroll actors compute them as parallax ratios of cameraTargetX / Y.

No extracted script references this actor by label (no spawn or entry reference found), so it is either unused or spawned from data; the claim in docs/code/bank08-native-dao-pyramid-actors.md that it is used during pyramid scroll sequences is unsupported (OQ-I038-4). UNVERIFIED-RUNTIME.

blockNote: Midpoint of two actors: posX ($14) and posY ($16) of the actor at DP $04 (A) and the actor at DP $06 (B), each summed and halved with a signed ROR (CLC / BPL / SEC before the ROR keeps the sign), stored into the caller's own $14 / $16. X is saved with PHX / PLX; Y is clobbered. Needs 16-bit A and index registers.

$04 and $06 are the actor's prevActorLink / nextActorLink (wram-memory-map). mtA0_acid_spider (code_0BA2BE) and awB0_zombie call it every frame from a SetEntryHere loop without setting either, so the child sits midway between its list neighbours; dm3D_flayzer calls it once to place a shot.

Callers: mtA0_acid_spider (2 sites), awB0_zombie, av6E_draco (2), dm3D_flayzer, unused_mode7_boss. combat_collision does not call it; the older 'used by combat collision to find the hit point' was wrong.
OQ-I038-3: when $06 is 0 (no successor) the B reads would hit low RAM at $0014 / $0016; whether callers guarantee a neighbour was not traced.
